title: 第7章 被惦记第8章 喊大爷饶命
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“师姐，你飞剑呢”两人在山道上跋涉，苏星河虽然已经踏入炼气境，也只是一层，此时正弯着腰，不停地的喘着粗气。
这灵隐峰方圆万里，草药场又是十分偏僻，只靠一双腿，苏星河有些气馁。
“我才炼气五层，哪里用得了飞剑！”李彩薇气定神闲，见苏星河狼狈，也不催促，不知从哪里又翻出一个仙果，咬一口，满脸的陶醉。
这是个吃货啊，也不知道分我一个，苏星河口干舌燥，吞了下口水。
“收徒那天，我看到你与峰主一起御剑而下，并且一直半空悬浮，怎么现在又不会了？”苏星河提出自己的疑问。
“那是有爷爷的气机牵引，就像我们回宗门时一样，不过是连同我的剑也一起了！”说着，她手心一翻，果然拿出一把长剑，剑身细而薄，流光溢彩，显然不是凡品。
“这是灵器飞剑？”苏星河试探的问。
“灵器？你想什么呢！灵器何等的稀有，我一个炼气修士哪有，况且，灵器威力巨大，但使用条件也苛刻，没达到筑基期，根本就发挥不出强大力量。”
李彩薇说话也不忘吃，口里塞满仙果，话也说的断断续续。
“那只是寻常剑？可看着青光闪闪，不像凡品！”苏星河一入门就被安排到草药场，除了一本基础修炼功法，其他还是一无所知。
“当然不是，法器，而且是上品法器！你个土鳖，怎么什么都不懂！”李彩薇无情嘲讽苏星河的无知。
虽是嘲讽，但语气更多是调侃，并不是真的鄙视。
“师姐你知道，我刚入门就被安排到了草药场，还没来得及学习。”
“喏，这个给你，你资质不够，都没资格进入授业堂，自学吧，有不懂的可以问我。”说着，抛出一本书，接着又补充道：“我有空的话！”
苏星河接过，厚厚一本，书名简单四个字：《基础杂项》，随手翻开目录，包括修行体系，修炼技法，法器，丹药，灵材，甚至连妖兽，以及魔道介绍都有提及。
“多谢师姐！”
两人边走边聊，为了照顾苏星河，李彩薇放慢了脚步，保持跟他一个频率。
“怎么不收起来？”本就走的不快，苏星河手里拎着书，晃来晃去，倒更慢了一些。
“啊？收到哪里？”苏星河茫然。
“你还没有储物袋？”

“没有。”苏星河诚实回答。
“也对，没有进入炼气境前，无法运转灵力，储物袋也打不开，只有达到炼气一层的弟子，才能领取储物袋，这点我到忘了。”李彩薇解释。
“额......”
苏星河无语，这真是不太聪明的样子，这也能忘。
两人边聊边走，其实苏星河可以汲取瓷瓶中的灵气，将脚力提高一倍，但如此一来，就暴露了自己身怀异宝，虽然这个姑娘看起来没什么心眼儿，但毕竟没到完全可以信任的地步，还是不要节外生枝了。
“到了！前面就是外门范围了。”李彩薇指着不远处成片的屋舍，一道门楼上刀刻斧凿着三个大字：灵隐峰。
“丹房在哪？”苏星河直奔主题，对清一色整齐排列的房舍不感兴趣。
“快到了，跟我来就是了。”
“师姐，峰主找你呢！”路上有外门弟子主动招呼。
“知道了！”李彩薇一努嘴，神情不悦。
“宗主找你有重要的事吧，要不我自己去领丹药吧？”苏星河听对方说是峰主找，觉着事情肯定小不了，因为自己这点小事耽误不值当。
“能有什么重要的事儿，还不是修炼！无聊！”李彩薇原本喜悦的神情，肉眼可见的消散，此时手中仙果都不香了，狠狠地扔向一旁。
“真是人比人，气死人，有的人，有个峰主当爷爷，上赶着指点修行，人还不乐意！自己想找个人指点，都没人理睬！”苏星河心里感慨，真是天道不公。
左转右转，苏醒转的晕头转向，见识了这外门的繁华鼎盛，终于在一处丹药堂前停住。
“到了，进去吧。”李彩薇当先进入，跨过外门，直奔内堂。
“采薇师姐！”
“采薇师姐！”
......
不少排队领丹药的弟子，主动跟采薇打招呼，采薇只是点头示意。
苏星河突然看到一个熟悉面孔，一个着青衣的圆脸小胖子，正是测灵根时，第一个上场的腼腆少年，没记错的话，还是中品灵根。

“是你！”小胖子脸现喜色，显然也认出了苏星河，当然不是因为苏星河天赋有多好，只是最后他不要脸的跪地恳求拜入宗门的表现，让他印象深刻，着绝对是个脸皮比鞋底还厚的家伙。
“我叫苏星河，你呢！”
同一批入门的弟子，往往会走的更近一些，尤其在这种修仙宗门，各种势力林立，新人地位低，很难融入老势力，新人抱团取暖尤为重要。
“我叫蒋星辰！她叫林佳！”名叫蒋星辰的小胖子少年，身旁的少女，笑着介绍。
苏星河对这个小姑娘没什么印象，只记得是个下品灵根，圆圆的脸蛋，跟小胖子到有几分相似，若非姓氏不同，苏星河还以为这是一对兄妹。
content_en:
"Sister, where is your flying sword?" The two of them were trekking on the mountain road. Although Su Xinghe had already entered the Qi Refining Realm, he was only on the first level. He was currently bending over and panting heavily.
Lingyin Peak is thousands of miles away, and the herbal field is very remote. With only one pair of legs, Su Xinghe is a little discouraged.
"I'm only at the fifth level of qi refining, how can I use a flying sword!" Li Caiwei was calm and calm. Seeing Su Xinghe's embarrassment, she didn't rush her. She dug out another fairy fruit from somewhere and took a bite, her face full of intoxication.
He was a foodie, and he didn’t know who to share with me. Su Xinghe’s mouth was dry and he swallowed.
"On the day you accepted a disciple, I saw you and the Peak Master wielding swords together, and they were suspended in mid-air. Why can't you do it again now?" Su Xinghe asked his own question.
"It was pulled by grandpa's energy, just like when we returned to the sect, but it came with my sword!" As she said that, she turned her palm over and took out a long sword. The sword was thin and thin, and it was full of brilliance. It was obviously not an ordinary sword.
"Is this a flying sword, a spiritual weapon?" Su Xinghe asked tentatively.
"Spiritual weapons? What are you thinking! Spiritual weapons are so rare. How can I, a Qi Refining monk, have them? Moreover, spiritual weapons are powerful, but the conditions for their use are also harsh. If they have not reached the foundation building stage, they will not be able to exert their powerful power at all."
Li Caiwei did not forget to eat while talking, her mouth was filled with fairy fruit, and she spoke intermittently.
"Is that just an ordinary sword? But the green light is shining, it doesn't look like an ordinary sword!" Su Xinghe was assigned to the herbal medicine field as soon as he entered. Except for a book on basic cultivation techniques, he knew nothing else.
"Of course not, it's a magic weapon, and it's a top-grade magic weapon! You idiot, how come you don't understand anything!" Li Caiwei ruthlessly mocked Su Xinghe's ignorance.
Although it was sarcasm, the tone was more of ridicule and not really contempt.
"Senior sister, you know, I was assigned to the herbal medicine field as soon as I started, and I didn't have time to learn."
"Here, this is for you. You don't have enough qualifications to enter the teaching hall. Study on your own. If you don't understand anything, you can ask me." He said, throwing out a book, and then added: "If I have time!"
Su Xinghe took it and found a thick book with a simple four-character title: "Basic Miscellaneous". He flipped through the catalogue, which included cultivation systems, cultivation techniques, magic weapons, elixirs, spiritual materials, and even introductions to monsters and magic.
"Thank you, senior sister!"
The two chatted while walking. In order to take care of Su Xinghe, Li Caiwei slowed down and kept on the same frequency as him.
"Why don't you put it away?" Su Xinghe was already walking slowly, holding the book in his hand and dangling it, but he walked even slower.
"Ah? Where did you receive it?" Su Xinghe was confused.
"You don't have a storage bag yet?"
"No." Su Xinghe answered honestly.
"That's right. Before entering the Qi Refining Realm, you can't use your spiritual power and the storage bag can't be opened. Only disciples who have reached the first level of Qi Refining can receive the storage bag. I forgot about this." Li Caiwei explained.
"Um..."
Su Xinghe was speechless. This was really not very smart. This could be forgotten.
The two walked while chatting. In fact, Su Xinghe could absorb the spiritual energy in the porcelain bottle and double the strength of his legs. However, in doing so, he would have revealed that he was carrying a rare treasure. Although this girl seemed to have no intentions, after all, she was not completely trustworthy, so it was better not to get into trouble.
"We're here! The outer gate is just ahead." Li Caiwei pointed to the cluster of houses not far away. There were three large characters carved on a gate: Lingyin Peak.
"Where is the alchemy room?" Su Xinghe went straight to the topic and was not interested in the neatly arranged buildings.
"We're almost there, just follow me."
"Senior sister, the Peak Master is looking for you!" An outer disciple greeted him on the road.
"I know!" Li Caiwei pouted, looking unhappy.
"The Sect Master has something important to do with you. How about I go get the elixir myself?" Su Xinghe heard that the other party said that the Peak Master was looking for him, so he felt that the matter must be something serious.Sorry, it's not worth the delay because of such a trivial matter.
"What's the important thing? It's not cultivation! It's boring!" Li Caiwei's original joyful expression dissipated visibly. At this time, the fairy fruit in her hand no longer smelled good, and she threw it aside.
"It's really annoying to compare people to each other. Some people have a peak master as their grandfather, and they rush to give guidance on cultivation, but they are not happy! I want to find someone to give guidance, but no one pays attention!" Su Xinghe sighed in his heart, it is really unfair.
Turning left and right, Su Xingzhuan was dizzy, seeing the prosperity of the outer gate, and finally stopped in front of a pill hall.
"We're here, let's go in." Li Caiwei entered first, stepped through the outer door, and went straight to the inner hall.
"Senior Sister Caiwei!"
"Senior Sister Caiwei!"
...
Many disciples who were queuing up to receive the elixir took the initiative to say hello to Caiwei, but Caiwei just nodded.
Su Xinghe suddenly saw a familiar face, a round-faced little fat man in Tsing Yi. He was the shy young man who was the first to appear during the spiritual root test. If he remembered correctly, he was still a middle-grade spiritual root.
"It's you!" The little fat man's face lit up, and he obviously recognized Su Xinghe. Of course, it wasn't because of how talented Su Xinghe was. It was just the way he shamelessly knelt down and begged to join the sect in the end that left a deep impression on him. He was definitely a guy with a thicker skin than the soles of his shoes.
"My name is Su Xinghe, and what's yours?"
Disciples who start in the same group tend to get closer. Especially in this kind of immortal sect, where there are many different forces and newcomers have low status, it is difficult to integrate into the old forces. It is especially important for newcomers to stay together for warmth.
"My name is Jiang Xingchen! Her name is Lin Jia!" The fat boy named Jiang Xingchen, the girl next to him, introduced with a smile.
Su Xinghe didn't have much impression of this little girl. He only remembered that she was a low-grade spiritual root and had a round face that was somewhat similar to that of a fat guy. If it weren't for the different surnames, Su Xinghe would have thought they were a brother and sister.
